story.heading: A spark in Class 12
story.description: My interest in marketing began with something I came across online during Class 12. Curiosity led me to blogs, videos and books, including Philip Kotler’s Marketing Management and Seth Godin’s work.

story.heading: A structured foundation
story.description: I wanted a connected understanding of marketing, so I researched courses and chose the three-month UT Digital Media programme by Umar Tazkeer. Alongside my BBA studies, it gave me a foundation to keep building on.

story.heading: Turning learning into practice
story.description: I practised keyword and audience research, campaign structure, ad copy, budget planning, landing-page analysis and conversion tracking with GA4 and Google Tag Manager. The work taught me to connect the customer, the message and the action being measured.

story.heading: Building DigitalTalha
story.description: I created DigitalTalha to give that work a name and a home. It is a solo personal brand: when you work with me, you work directly with me. My aim is to keep improving through useful work and evidence, without inflated claims.

principles.heading: Research before execution
principles.description: Understand the business, audience and offer before making a recommendation.

principles.heading: Clear communication
principles.description: Explain what is happening and why, in plain language.

principles.heading: Testing over guessing
principles.description: Use structured tests and available data instead of treating assumptions as facts.

principles.heading: Honest reporting
principles.description: Discuss what is working, what is not, and what still needs evidence.

principles.heading: Direct involvement
principles.description: Work with me throughout the agreed project, from the first brief to review.

principles.heading: Continuous improvement
principles.description: Keep learning from the work and use that learning to improve the next version.

how_i_think_about_the: How I think about the work
the_practical_work_behind_the: The practical work behind the services.
advertising_should_make_a_useful: Advertising should make a useful solution easy to understand.
before_writing_an_ad_or: Before writing an ad or planning a page, I want to understand the audience, the problem they have, what they care about and why they would choose one solution over another.
a_campaign_a_website_and: A campaign, a website and an SEO plan all need that foundation. I review the available evidence, explain what it means and use it to decide what needs changing. The first version is a starting point to learn from.
i_m_talha_a_freelance: I’m Talha, a freelance digital marketer and BBA student at Amity University. DigitalTalha is my personal brand, built around research, testing and honest communication.
paid_advertising_is_my_main: Paid advertising is my main focus. Website creation and SEO connect that work with a clearer home for your services and a useful path from search to enquiry.
my_foundation_is_in_paid: My foundation is in paid search and paid social, supported by website and search work. These are areas I study and put into practice; this list is not a claim of certification or client results.
